units: <cite ref="Mishnah Moed Katan 1:2">M. Kat. I, 2</cite> (<cite ref="Moed Katan 2a:3">2ᵃ</cite>) <he>ומתקנין את קִילְקוּלֵי המים וכ׳</he> and you may cure the spoiled waters (clean the pools) during the festive week.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 4:5:5">Y. Taan. IV, 68ᶜ</cite> <he>ק׳ חשבונות יש כאן</he> there is a disarrangement of dates here (a new era was started with the destruction of the Temple), v. <cite ref="S01415"><he>קִלְקֵל</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nedarim 6:8:13">Y. Ned. VI, end, 40ᵃ</cite>; Y. Snh. I, 19ᵃ top <he>הן דלא … בק׳</he> where he (R. Judah) did not get (to announce the decision of the Palestinian court on the intercalation), they were guided by the disarrangement (the calendar established by Hananiah).

<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 64a:16">Ab. Zar. 64ᵃ</cite> <he>שמא יחזור לקִלְקוּלוֹ</he> lest he (the proselyte) may go back to his corruption (idolatry); (<cite ref="Kiddushin 17b:17">Kidd. 17ᵇ</cite> <he>לסורו</he>, v. <cite ref="O00412"><he>סוֹר</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 9:2">Num. R. s. 9</cite> <he>תחלת קלקולו בעזה וכ׳</he> the beginning of his degeneration took place at Gaza, therefore he was punished at Gaza; <cite ref="Tosefta Sotah 3:15">Tosef. Sot. III, 15</cite>; Mekh. B’shall, Shir., s. 2 <he>קִלְקָלוֹ</he>; Tanḥ.
